notes: The 40 W dual USB-C CD213 (12-24 V input, 4.5 A), which has two small boards with the same circuit. The parts are from one April 2021 teardown unit, so other production runs may differ.

gaps: The teardown's spec printout gives 40 W max, which is kept; retailer listings seen name other ratings (36 W in URLs whose pages showed no product text, 60 W in one page title), so variants are unconfirmed.
Search results list a second 充电头网 CD213 teardown (article 134617) said to show different chips (SP1259HN, SW2303); it was not opened, so those chips are not claimed and units may differ by batch.
No quantities are set: the article says both boards have the same circuit and one buck inductor and filter capacitor on each, but gives no totals.
No fuse rating, inductor value or capacitor maker is claimed.
Datasheet links dropped: the oneyac SC8112 brief PDF would not open (fetch failed three times), and the szlcsc RU30L30M PDF shows a Yatelian logo and no Ruichips name.
The LCSC page names the ordering code SC8112QDJR; the article gives the chip only as SC8112.
method: Re-sourced 2026-11-12 under the project owner's rule not to cite ChargerLAB: the research agent's English-language teardown is not cited, every claim was re-checked against the Chinese original on chongdiantou.com, and claims only the English page supported were dropped.

充电头网 (chongdiantou.com) teardown of the UGREEN 40W dual USB-C car charger CD213 by 捣蛋猫, 2021-04-27: https://www.chongdiantou.com/archives/76366.html. Only this one article page was opened; no archive pages or reposts.
The article names the chip makers in Chinese (南芯, 慧能泰, 锐骏半导体); Southchip, Hynetek and Ruichips are their usual English names.
LCSC product page C782181 (Southchip SC8112QDJR) opens with no bot check and shows a 4.6-36 V operating range, 6 A, two outputs; it is kept as the chip's reference and no field rests on it.
homescreen.pl listing pages loaded as the shop homepage, and dateks.lv returned HTTP 403; neither was used.

comps.spec: Southchip (南芯) SC8112 dual-output 6 A synchronous step-down converter with built-in switches, output voltage set by divider resistors; used on both boards
Hynetek (慧能泰) HUSB339 USB-C power delivery controller, SOP-14L or QFN-16L package options; passed PD3.0 certification (TID 62) and lists PD2.0, PD3.0, PPS, QC2.0/3.0 and BC1.2; used on both boards
Ruichips (锐骏半导体) RU30L30M P-channel MOSFET, 30 V, PDFN3333 package; the output VBUS switch
Step-down (buck) inductor, one on each of the two boards, wrapped in heat-shrink tubing
Input filter electrolytic capacitor, 35 V 100 uF (one on each board)
Buck output filter solid capacitor, 16 V 220 uF (one on each board)
SMD fuse, shown in a close-up photo

Two USB-C output ports with black plastic cores and no exposed copper, which the article says support blind insertion; the spec printout gives each port 5 V 3 A, 9 V 2.22 A or 12 V 1.67 A, 40 W max in total
Power indicator LED at the output end, lights blue when powered
Input spring contact with a red wire on it, which the article says lowers resistance
